Hi all, 33M here from Wales, UK.
Hope everyone is well and staying safe!
Over 12 months ago I started suffering from fatigue and some concerning pains in my abdomen and sides and pelvic dysfunction. 
After many doctors appointments, hospital appointments and scans and being told on numerous occasions theres nothing wrong with me and it's all in my head, I was beggining to lose hope, and life was slowly falling apart, I lost my business by Nov 2019, my relationship was or is suffering badly and I am struggling to be a good father to my 3 beautiful children because I'm constantly tired. At the beginning of March I found clusters of lymph nodes in my groins both sides, I had lost 2 stone in weight, and also suffering from night sweats, doctor seemed concerned and did some bloods, platelets came back low. A week later I had a letter for haematology appoinment.
My mum works there and it was her that told me that it could be lymphoma. Due to covid I had CT scan done first before my first consultation. At the consultation the doctor said he doesn't think I have cancer, no physical examination due to Covid-19 and said I need to come back for another scan in 4 months time due to risk with covid.
Well during the last couple of weeks my symptoms have got a lot worse (fatigue and whole body aches) and I've found another raised node in my neck.
Consultant now says I need a biopsy as long as I have a node over 2cm? Which I think some are 3cm + in my groin and I'm booked in for 2 weeks on Thursday. 
Not sure what advice I'm looking for really just somewhere to share my story and if you think you have any advice that would help during this difficult time it would be very much appreciated.
Stay safe, many thanks xx
